Your Porto weekend note now has a trip page, under **Page** in the note.

- **Countdown:** it shows 11 days to go until Fri 16 Oct. I set the start date in the page's own settings, so the countdown doesn't read it from your note text.
- **At a glance:** the flights, hotel (with confirmation number and check-in time) and budget.
- **Ideas:** a tickable list with a progress bar.
- **To do before:** your three to-dos, with the insurance one already ticked.

I made two small changes to the note text so the page could read it. "ideas" and "to do before" are now headings, and the idea bullets are checkboxes. I also changed "budget ~ 6000 kr total" to "budget: ~ 6000 kr total" so it shows up in the at-a-glance section.

  "guide": "# Building Amber Notes pages

A page turns a note into a small app: a habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a reading log. The note's markdown is the data and stays the source of truth: the person can always flip to Text and see and edit every row. The page is a view and a remote control for that data. Deleting or replacing a page never loses data.
